page.layout: One page of text, centred verse followed by a dedication and signature; a printed ornament below the signature. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.p:
Dona sinu generosa IACCHI.
Audentiorem BEZA decus lyræ
Me reddit: & qui fidus APOLLINIS
Custos PALATINI MELISSVS:
Queis citharæ placuere cantus,
Qua subiugatas ante BRITANNICO
Classes IBERAS littore diximus,
Votisque REGINÆ precantis
Supplicitèr SVPEROS fauentes;
Et turbulentos PONTIFICVM dolos,
Et magna pacis præmia ciuicæ
GALLOS timentes: atque nondum
REGNA suis satiata damnis.

page.notes: The verse is set in a mix of italic and roman capitals; the scan is faint in places. The reading "Supplicitèr" and "Qua subiugatas" follow the printed forms as best visible. The ornament below the signature is a printer's fleuron and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible on the right and has been omitted. Uncertain readings: "Qua subiugatas" (the line may read "Quas subiugatas"), "ciuicæ" (possibly "ciuicæ" as printed), and "Iacomotus" (possibly "Iacomotus" as printed). Check against the original if exact spelling matters.
